answer: Make every newcomer grow from a vine: an established agent must graft it by staking 5% of its own spendable balance, and may graft at most two sprouts per epoch. If a sprout is later shown to share keys or hosting with its sponsor's other sprouts, the whole graft chain back to the sponsor is slashed. A sybil farm then can't appear overnight like a hollow oasis mirage; it must grow one costly, slashable branch at a time, and honest sponsors refuse risky grafts.
